body:
## Correction: the extent was overstated — the blind spot itself is real, and this stays open

Filed from PR #10755, which went red on `Type Check · debt ledger` at `ca022387f2` and
is what measured this.

**What this card claimed:** `packages/objectql/scripts/**` "is in no tsc program at
all".

**What is true:** `packages/objectql/scripts/**` is invisible to the package's **own**
`tsc -p` — that half is exactly right, `include` is `["src/**/*"]` and the directory is
not under it — but it is **not** invisible to every tsc program.

The TEST_DEBT re-measure builds a different project. `measureTestDebt` calls
`remeasureProject` (`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`), which copies the package
tsconfig and drops every test glob from `exclude`. That makes
`packages/objectql/src/dry-run-hash-compat.test.ts` a root file, and its line 5 is:

```ts
import { runDryRun, type LegacyMetadataRow } from '../scripts/dry-run-hash-compat';
```

tsc pulls every transitively imported file into the program regardless of `include`, so
the script **is** compiled there — reached through the test, not through `include`.

Measured, both directions, with objectql's dependency closure built first:

```
re-measure project (include src/**/*, test globs dropped from exclude):
  with    import.meta.url in scripts/dry-run-hash-compat.ts   356 raw tsc errors
  without it (seeded from __filename instead)                 355 raw tsc errors
  the one line that leaves:
    packages/objectql/scripts/dry-run-hash-compat.ts(279,40): error TS1470: The
    'import.meta' meta-property is not allowed in files which will build into
    CommonJS output.

pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck   exit 0 in BOTH states
```

`TEST_DEBT['@objectstack/objectql']` is frozen at 355, so the extra error read as an
upward ledger drift on a package the coverage ratchet reports as covered.

Why the ablation in the body could not see this: it ran the package's own `typecheck`
and a `--listFiles` over the package's own config, and that is precisely the program
the file is missing from. It never built the test-inclusive project. The ablation was
sound; only the conclusion drawn from it reached past what it measured.

**Not closing this, and the correction argues for the gate rather than against it.**
The accidental coverage is not a property anyone declared: it holds only for the files
some test happens to import, only while that import exists, and it reports as a drifted
count on a shrink-only debt ledger rather than through the package's own `typecheck`.
A source directory unread by the check its package advertises is still the finding.
The body has been corrected in place; the title was already accurate.

## fold-or-serial — answered, as triage required

**FOLD.** Both cards are the same instrument (`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`) and #10779 is specifically `remeasureProject`, which #10756's own census has to reason about. Serialising them would make the second agent re-derive the first's measurements on a file the first just changed. ⛔ Neither is dispatched separately; this claim covers both.

⭐ **Serial cleared:** PR **#10820** rewrote this file (+469/−19, adding `compositionAt` and a composition check over `TEST_DEBT`) and **merged at ~13:45Z**. Branch from current `origin/main`; every line number and count on both cards predates it, so **re-derive everything**.

⚠️ #10756's body was **corrected by its own author** (comment 1): `packages/objectql/scripts/**` is invisible to the package's **own** `tsc -p`, which is true — but it is **not** invisible to every tsc program, because the TEST_DEBT re-measure builds a different project. Carry the corrected extent, not the body's first claim.

Scope from triage: **census first** (how many "covered" packages have a real source directory outside their own tsc program), **then a remedy sized to the count** — the `tsconfig.scripts.json` sibling pattern if few, a ratchet limb comparing tracked `.ts` files against `tsc --listFiles` if many. ⛔ **Strengthening only; no gate weakening in scope, and ⛔ never raise the shrink-only TEST_DEBT baseline.**
## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` — propose wording in the report.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree of the repo.
- ⚠️ **A pipe swallows the exit code.** Capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ ⭐ **NEW, measured today (#10853): `pnpm --filter <name>` with a name that does not exist prints `No projects matched the filters` and EXITS 0.** A whole verification round can be fictitious and read as green. **Verify your filter actually matched** before trusting any run. (My own briefing carried a wrong package name this morning and a dev caught it.)
- ⚠️ Apply labels **additively** (`POST /issues/N/labels`), never a whole-set PUT; read them back after the size labeler runs.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.
